title: UAE: AI in healthcare rules
summary: Abu Dhabi DoH Responsible AI Standard, effective Oct 2025 (transparency, explainability, patient opt-out, security). Global AI Healthcare Academy. Dubai: AI policy since 2021; staff AI training since Apr 2025.
fact: Abu Dhabi hospitals now have a written standard staff must understand. No official source says AI training is mandatory for UAE doctors. Don't claim it.
caution: Binding? DoH standards generally mandatory for Abu Dhabi facilities (verify). Never imply foreign rules bind Armenian or Gulf hospitals.
